_: The Atlas coverage register (James, 23 Nov 2026: 'so Atlas can now grow with the site build'). Every public section and every record page route of the site is either FED into the Atlas by a named feeder in lib/atlas/build.ts, or listed OUTSIDE with the reason. tests/atlas-coverage.test.ts fails the build when a new section or record route appears in app/ and is in neither list, so a new volume cannot ship without the Atlas knowing about it.

feeders.label: Stays
feeders.note: Every stay with a published page. Gatherings residences, Other Europe houses and The Exceptional Few are stays on the Ledger, so they arrive here.

feeders.label: Dated sailings
feeders.note: One row per published sailing with its own page. Shown when the search gives dates or names the sailing; otherwise her ship stands for them.

feeders.label: What's Coming
feeders.note: Announced, opening and rebuilding places that have no stay page yet. Shown as not open; never under a category.

routes./collections/[slug]: A collection is a filter in the Atlas (The Exceptional Few, Timeless Voyages), not a result.
routes./destinations/[region]: A place is what the traveller types in Where, not a result.
routes./destinations/[region]/[country]: A place is what the traveller types in Where, not a result.
routes./destinations/[region]/[country]/[place]: A place is what the traveller types in Where, not a result.
routes./voyages/[waters]: A waters hub is a place, not a result.
routes./overland/[country]: A country hub is a place, not a result.
routes./pathways/[key]: A Wild Pathway feeds the Interests filter, not a result.
routes./partners/[partner]: Reading, not bookable. Second pass (James to rule).
routes./journal/[slug]: Reading, not bookable. Returned by the house search under Journal and field guides (James, 24 Nov 2026); not an Atlas result.
routes./wildlife/[slug]: Reading, not bookable. Returned by the house search under Wildlife (James, 24 Nov 2026); not an Atlas result.
routes./advisors/[slug]: People, not places. The Atlas returns where to go.
routes./booking/property/[slug]: Booking Live step, reached from a stay.
routes./journal-style/safaris/[reserve]: The locked design of a reserve page served at /safaris/<slug> by a rewrite; the reserve itself is fed by its own route.

sections.destinations: Places are the Atlas Where box.
sections.field-guides: Reading, not bookable. Returned by the house search under Journal and field guides (James, 24 Nov 2026); not an Atlas result.
sections.journal: Reading, not bookable. Returned by the house search under Journal and field guides (James, 24 Nov 2026); not an Atlas result.
sections.offers: Offers ride on the place they apply to; they are not results of their own.
sections.partners: Reading, not bookable. Second pass (James to rule).
sections.wildlife: Reading, not bookable. Returned by the house search under Wildlife (James, 24 Nov 2026); not an Atlas result.
sections.workshops: Sessions, not places. Second pass (James to rule).
